## Release Notes

### Bug Fixes

- *(config)* Rename `threads.capture` to `threads.enabled` ([#4785](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4785))
- *(setup)* Contrast on default Terminal.app ([#4780](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4780))
- *(setup)* Preserve line breaks in error messages ([#4784](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4784))
- *(setup)* Show the sign-in code to match against the Hub ([#4791](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4791))
- *(setup,common)* Keep stray log lines off the setup screen


### Features

- *(threads)* Support Mistral Vibe threads and MCP ([#4778](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4778))
- *(threads)* Change ctrl-] binding to ctrl-t ([#4786](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4786))


### Miscellaneous Tasks

- Enable `debug-embed` in `rust-embed` ([#4777](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4777))
- Update AGENTS.md disclosure instructions ([#4789](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4789))
- Fix/debug macOS tests ([#4790](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4790))


### Refactor

- *(deps)* Bump rmcp from 3.9.0 to 3.10.0 ([#4752](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4752))
- *(deps)* Bump tonic-prost from 0.14.6 to 0.14.9 ([#4750](https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/issues/4750))

# atuin 18.25.1

## Install atuin 18.25.1

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/releases/download/v18.25.1/atuin-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/atuinsh/atuin/releases/download/v18.25.1/atuin-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

detail.readme:
making your terminal magical

Atuin gives you, and your agents, a history of everything that happened in your terminal. **Shell history:** Atuin replaces your shell history with a SQLite database that records exit codes, working directories, hosts and durations. Hit Ctrl+R and find any command you've ever run, on any machine. **Agent threads:** Atuin captures your Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agent sessions. Start a thread on your laptop, then `atuin resume` it on a different machine, in a different harness. Your agents can, optionally, search everything that's ever happened through the built-in MCP server. Atuin can also sync both history and threads across all of your machines, end-to-end encrypted. Or it can work totally offline! # Quick Start ```bash curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://setup.atuin.sh | sh ``` Then, **restart your shell**. ## History Atuin captures everything you do in the terminal, storing it into a SQLite database. Hitting Ctrl+R opens a pretty pane with all your bash history. Atuin logs your *exit codes*, *working directories*, *hostnames*, *command duration* and much much more. You can hit Enter to execute a command, Tab to edit any highlighted command.

As well as the search UI, `atuin` has a CLI interface for searching commands: ```bash # search for all successful `make` commands, recorded after 3pm yesterday atuin search --exit 0 --after "yesterday 3pm" make ``` Finally, agents can search your history too, through our [MCP](https://docs.atuin.sh/latest/ai/mcp/). Atuin supports [ Zsh](https://www.zsh.org/), [ Bash](https://www.gnu.org/software/bash/), [ fish](https://fishshell.com/), [ Nushell](https://www.nushell.sh/), [ Xonsh](https://xon.sh/) and [ PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/). ### Sync Atuin can sync all your shell activity, across all your machines (even ephemeral ones). You can either use the official [Atuin Hub](https://atuin.sh) or you can self-host the sync server. **Everything it syncs is end-to-end encrypted.** ## Threads Atuin captures what your agents do. Automatically move your context and thread history from one machine to another, or from one harness to another. With *Atuin Threads*, your agent has access to your full history, and the built-in Atuin MCP gives your agent context on everything you've ever done. You can take a session you started on your personal computer in Claude Code, and `$ atuin resume` it in a remote machine inside Codex.

Similarly to the history index, you can search through your *threads*: ```bash atuin threads search 'c++' ``` > [!TIP] > > AI functionality is completely opt-in: `atuin setup` will ask you if you want > threads support, or, if you want your binary to have zero AI features, > disable the `ai` feature flag during compilation: > > ```bash > cargo install atuin --locked --no-default-features \ > --features client,sync,check-update,daemon,pty-proxy > ``` Supported harnesses are [ Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code), [ Codex](https://openai.com/codex/), [ Opencode](https://opencode.ai/), [ Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot), [ Grok](https://x.ai/build), [ Hermes](https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/), and many more. Atuin does so much more and we have [extensive documentation](https://docs.atuin.sh/)! If you ever need help, reach out to us through our [communities](#community). ## Related projects * [Catpuccin for Atuin](https://github.com/catppuccin/atuin) * [eshell-atuin](https://github.com/SqrtMinusOne/eshell-atuin) * [mob (tiny creatures in your terminal)](https://github.com/bboynton97/mob) Please open a PR for any others! # Community
